
## Set up

```{julia}
using CSV
using DataFrames
```

## Balloon system properties

```{julia}
free_lift = 5.0 # grams
balloon_weight = 38*2 # gram
balloon_volume = 0.15*2 # m^3
payload_weight = 20.0 # gram
gas = "helium 97%"
```

## Define gas properties

Gas density table in kg/cu m at 101.325 kPa at MSL

```{julia}
df_gas = CSV.read("""
    "name","0deg","15deg"
    "hydrogen",0.0899,0.0852
    "helium",0.1786,0.1693
    "helium 97%",0.2120,0.2010
    "air",1.2920,1.2247
""" |> IOBuffer, DataFrame)
```

## Computed balloon fill properties 

```{julia}
chosen_gas_density = df_gas[(df_gas.name .== gas),"15deg"]
air_density = df_gas[(df_gas.name .== "air"),"15deg"]
neck_lift = free_lift + payload_weight # gram
launch_gas_fill =
    (neck_lift + balloon_weight)/
    (air_density-chosen_gas_density)/1000.0

println("Neck lift          $(neck_lift) gram")
println("Gas fill at launch $(launch_gas_fill[1]) m^3")
```


## Define atmospheric profile

```{julia}
fname = "atmos.csv"
df_atmos = CSV.read(fname, DataFrame)
```
